eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: EasyTranslate
eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: Easily translate Text objects by defining their content for different languages.
description: Quickly localize your Text objects in GDevelop by defining different text values for each language. Simply add the extension to a Text object and configure the text you want to display for each supported language.

The extension automatically displays the appropriate text based on the selected language, making it easier to manage translations without creating separate events or manually changing the text of each object.
English is used as the default language, and additional languages can be configured as needed.
